comparisons.scope: One interleaved host trial, all owned copies and controller work paid. Same packet/image quality; no native or physical FPS conclusion.
One interleaved host trial, all owned copies and controller work paid. Same packet/image quality; no native or physical FPS conclusion.

scope: Same two reused 48-frame29.88fps source windows. Preprocessing shared once per source. Actual CP23/JA23 encode/decode, no hardware or frame clock.
Plain/eager/owned-lazy cohorts rotate order per frame. Snapshot copying happens before HUD and base; all copy, ownership checks and candidate work included in outer build_ms.
Owned bytes-backed snapshots prevent subsequent normal Python writes and source reuse through the bounded pool API. They do not make concurrent capture-to-copy atomic or supply a native fence.
One host trial; no confidence interval or general speedup. Guard-copy traffic and source-analysis calls are distinct from wire bytes.
No installed native codecs, ESP32 SRAM/DMA/RF, QSPI/FIFO schedule, FPGA timing/resource fit or physical30fps proof.
